Frontend: create form CategorySelect and Edit modal <select data-testid=edit-category> both list sub-categories; edit modal shows breadcrumb 'Fason Verme › QA_alt_kol'. Selecting sub-category in edit modal and saving persists task.category_id correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: tasks_router.list_task_categories(my_tasks) walks ancestor chain in-memory over up to 5000 rows per request. Fine at current scale; if categories grow, consider caching the by_id map or precomputing an inherited-visibility flag on write to keep O(depth) per row (already O(depth) but with fresh full fetch each call).
The _visible() ancestor walk uses `seen` set to guard cycles, which is correct; ensure the create/update endpoints reject cycles in parent_id to keep this defensive-only.

REMINDER_DAY_CHOICES option rendering triggers a React hydration warning (<span> child of <option>) in EditTaskModal.jsx around line 245 — not a functional bug but shows repeatedly in console. Consider rendering plain text child instead of the ve-dynamic <span>.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (create form + edit modal + save-persistence all verified)

rca of the issue: list_task_categories(scope=my_tasks) filtered categories using only direct visibility (owner company_id / visible_to_company_ids / visible_to_user_ids). Sub-categories inherit only company_id from parent — not the visibility grant fields — so they were filtered out of the my_tasks response and consequently missing from CategorySelect (create form) and edit-category <select> (edit modal). Fix (backend/routers/tasks_router.py:673+): build a by_id map and walk parent_id ancestor chain; a category is visible iff itself OR any ancestor is directly visible. Verified via pytest and via UI (create dropdown + edit modal breadcrumb 'Fason Verme › QA_alt_kol' + persistence on save).
